_readme: In-store specials. These only appear on the /in-store-specials/ page (top 3 also on the home page) and are written to be redeemed at the showroom. Fields: value = the big number/phrase in the card header (keep it to 2 or 3 words, e.g. 'Save $7,300', 'From $26,295', 'Free'); badge = small label; details = up to 3 short lines; claimCode = shown at the counter (null = no code needed); endsOn = YYYY-MM-DD or null; locations = ['all'] or store ids. Set active:false to hide. voucherDays = how many days a claimed voucher stays valid (default 7). voucherTerms = one line of fine print on the voucher.
pageIntro: These offers are only available when you visit the showroom. Claim one to get a personal Red Tag voucher, show it on your phone at the counter, or mention the code when you call ahead.

specials.title: Jacuzzi Clearance: 20% Off New 2026 Hot Tubs
specials.summary: Every remaining new 2026 Jacuzzi on our showroom floors carries the same red tag: 20% off until the floor is clear. Same 2026 models, same full Jacuzzi warranty, delivery and setup included. The only thing on clearance is the price.
details: 65 new Jacuzzi hot tubs across our Ontario showrooms, then it is over
Replaces the $1,000 off and free electrical offers, not combinable
0% financing for 12 months OAC on the reduced price
specials.voucherTerms: Applies to in-stock new 2026 Jacuzzi hot tub models while quantities last. Not combinable with the $1,000 off or free electrical offers. Present voucher with matching name and phone.

specials.title: Jacuzzi J-400 Floor Model Clearance
specials.summary: Showroom floor models from the 2025 J-400 series, fully inspected and covered by the full Jacuzzi warranty. Limited to what each showroom has on the floor.
specials.voucherTerms: One floor model per household. Subject to remaining inventory at this showroom. Present voucher with matching name and phone.

specials.title: Try Before You Buy: Book a Wet Test
specials.summary: Bring your swimsuit and try the seats, jets and lounger before you decide. We fill and heat a tub for you, no pressure and no charge.
